colors.name: stock-black
colors.role: background — the darkroom at safelight, a deep warm brown-black; the whole strip is laid down on it

colors.name: negative
colors.role: the true-black margins, sprocket gutter, and footer stage — darker than stock-black so the stills read as lit paper

colors.name: paper
colors.role: primary text on the strip and the proof-sheet labels — the warm off-white of a contact print (12.6:1 on stock-black)

colors.name: paper-dim
colors.role: secondary text — paper desaturated toward the base, ≈ 8.4:1; captions, Korean glosses, the lighter edges of a still

colors.name: amber
colors.role: the accent: the grease-pencil selection ring, focus state, the cover-line's small caps, the frame counter's leader. A warm Kodak gold (5.9:1 on stock-black)

colors.name: faded-red
colors.role: the one warm alarm — reserved for the light-leak flare, the selected frame's number, and a single struck exposure. Large type & non-text only (4.3:1 on stock-black)

colors.name: leak-orange
colors.role: the light-leak sweep and halation glow core — never carries text; pure light, composited as a screen-blended gradient

colors.name: sepia
colors.role: warm metadata — frame numbers, exposure data, the colophon's labels, the strip edge print (4.9:1 on stock-black)

colors.name: hairline
colors.role: decorative rules and the contact-sheet grid lines — stock-black warmed and lifted; never carries text

fonts.role: the cover-line and section display — a high-contrast display serif, italic for captions
every Hangul glyph — the Korean line is a serif voice of its own, reached by stack fallthrough and pinned by :lang(ko)
the machine: frame numbers, exposure data, sprocket labels, the colophon metadata

texture: Three analog layers, all procedural, all dead under prefers-reduced-motion. (1) A DOM grain: an SVG feTurbulence data-URI tile (baseFrequency 0.9, desaturated, warm-tinted) over the whole strip at 9% opacity, jumped between six fixed offsets by a steps(1) transform at ~0.22s per position — discrete frames of silver-halide stock, not drifting smoke. (2) The light leak: a leak-orange radial gradient sweeping diagonally across the cover and the contact sheet, a slow 11.4s linear loop whose opacity is screen-blended so it reads as flare over the warm base; a faded-red secondary leak breathes at 0.13Hz on the cover only. (3) Halation: every still's highlight (the leak-orange core) bleeds through a wide blurred amber radial behind the frame — the chemical bloom of overexposed film. Grain never animates layout; the leak uses transform/opacity only.

motion.name: ease-develop
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1) — reveals develop fast then settle, like chemistry biting into paper

motion.name: grain-step
motion.value: 1.3s steps(1, end) infinite across six offsets — a new frame of stock, not a drift

motion.name: leak-sweep
motion.value: 11.4s linear infinite; the leak-orange diagonal translates across the strip, screen-blended

motion.name: leak-breath
motion.value: 7.6s ease-in-out infinite; faded-red cover leak opacity 0.55 → 0.85 — a slow chemical exhale

motion.name: halation-glow
motion.value: 4.6s ease-in-out infinite; the still's amber halo radius ±8% — overexposure breathing

motion.name: scrub-lerp
motion.value: 0.14 per 60fps-normalized frame — the developing stills trail the scroll like photo paper taking up chemistry

motion.name: clip-sprocket
motion.value: inset() driven from full (hidden) to none (developed) via CSS var --reel-develop-p, 0→1 scrubbed

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: 640ms ease-develop, translateY(16px) → 0 + opacity 0 → 1, 80ms stagger per observer batch

motion.name: scanline-drift
motion.value: 8.2s linear infinite; the projector's scan band translates -100% → 100% across the strip, additive at 4% — a film projector, not a CRT

motion.name: cover-rise
motion.value: 820ms ease-develop per glyph, translateY(0.4em) → 0, 60ms stagger from 240ms
